title: Banff Yoho Parks | Lake Louise | Moraine | Emerald - Private Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore three of Banff and Yoho National Park’s top attractions—Lake Louise, Moraine Lake and Emerald Lake —on this budget-friendly, private tour. Perfect for travelers seeking the freedom to explore at their own pace without annoying travel joiners on a shared shuttle. 

Start Your Adventure in Downtown Banff or Calgary

First, visit Lake Louise, where you’ll be enchanted by the lake’s shimmering turquoise waters and the stunning peaks that surround it. Stroll along the lakeshore or take in the peaceful views.

Explore Moraine Lake and take a hike to the rock file to have a picture perfect view of the lake.

Next, head to Emerald Lake to experience its scenic green color. Take a short stop in a dramatic viewpoints and photo spots of this natural bridge masterpiece.

Conclude at Banff 
Free time to explore the town before heading back to Calgary.
